newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers steady to lower, quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers steady to lower, quiet trade.

text.p: North American bunker prices were lower to steady in quiet trade late this week but players said on Thursday fundamentals seem to point to a downtrend.
Stocks in the West Coast and northern East Coast were reported at good levels amid not much demand and few enquiries.
New York Harbor 380 CST traded between $107 a tonne and $108 a tonne, level with last week. 180 CST was up $1 at $111/113, players said.
Houston 380 CST one the Gulf Coast broke the $100 level due to one aggressive supplier trying to sell.
